heading: Birthday songs
description: Celebrate with Vocal U. Request a personalized birthday video for $5 or an in-person birthday song for $50 from the University of Minnesota a cappella group.
intro: Have us sing for someone on their birthday! Send a personalized video or bring Vocal U to the celebration in person.

packages.title: Birthday video
packages.description: A personalized Happy Birthday video from Vocal U, recorded for your birthday person.
packages.details: Tell us their name and when you need it. We'll coordinate delivery with you by email.

packages.title: In-person song
packages.description: Have us sing Happy Birthday or Birthday Sex in person. You choose the song; we'll bring the harmonies.
packages.details: Send us your preferred day, time, and location. We'll confirm what works with our group.
